about_the_game:
Sweet Chaos is a car shooter in which you lead cute heroes into battle against the armies of evil.

Masses of Enemies

Embark on a battle with your cute little hero against countless creatures. Don't be intimidated by the number of enemies! Be brave and defeat the enemy army.

Improve Your Power

Improve your skills between missions and test new combinations while continually earning new rewards. Hundreds of challenges await you and your fellow players.

Play with Friends!

Sweet Chaos was designed to offer a fast-paced and exciting gaming experience while maintaining focus and fun. Prepare to enjoy the game with your friends for hours.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows Vista or newer
  • Processor: Quad core processor
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 10 capable hardware
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 or newer
  • Processor: Quad core processor
  • Memory: 6 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 960 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Destroy countless enemies with powerful weapons and impressive spells! Upgrade your skills to counter the masses of enemies! Sweet Chaos is a Auto-Shooter with cute heroes and diverse worlds.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Polish, Czech
